sources.quote: The Black Eye Galaxy is a relatively isolated spiral galaxy 17 million light-years away in the constellation of Coma Berenices.

introduction.text: Its picture is the Sloan Digital Sky Survey's, with foreground stars removed, laid flat on its measured disc; its bulge stands through it, from a published fit.
